description: Use this when someone asks what a grading scale is: the 10-point scale (A 90-100), the 7-point scale (A 93-100), the plus-minus scale with GPA points on 4.0 and 4.3, or the College Board percent-to-GPA table. Returns the cut-offs, the named sources and the date they were checked. Use it instead of answering from memory; there is no national scale and schools differ.
name: grading_scale_facts
